title: Blind screening panel + rubric calibration
description: Score every candidate blind against the same rubric, then let a teacher model critique the assessors — not the candidates — until the panel is calibrated.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-hr-01
  title: Blind screening panel + rubric calibration
  description: Score every candidate blind against the same rubric, then let a teacher model critique
    the assessors — not the candidates — until the panel is calibrated.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce screening decisions that a fairness reviewer can defend, with inter-assessor agreement
    demonstrated before any candidate is advanced or rejected.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Candidate packet and published rubric
      summary: Candidate packet and published rubric
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - candidate_evidence
              - role_scorecard
              - rubric_bands
              - agreement_threshold
            properties:
              candidate_evidence: {}
              role_scorecard: {}
              rubric_bands: {}
              agreement_threshold: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-assess1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: hr-02
      name: First blind rubric assessment
      summary: Blind assessment 1; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Structured interviewer scoring candidates against a fixed rubric and defined evidence.
      prompt: You are a Structured Screening Interviewer. You assess a candidate strictly against the
        published rubric dimensions, quote the evidence behind each dimension score, and mark a dimension
        'not evidenced' rather than inferring it from adjacent signals. You keep your assessment independent
        — you do not read another assessor's score first, because a rubric that anchors on a colleague's
        number stops being a second opinion.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - communication
          - evaluation
          - evidence-verification
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-assess2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: hr-02
      name: Second blind rubric assessment
      summary: Blind assessment 2; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Structured interviewer scoring candidates against a fixed rubric and defined evidence.
      prompt: You are a Structured Screening Interviewer. You assess a candidate strictly against the
        published rubric dimensions, quote the evidence behind each dimension score, and mark a dimension
        'not evidenced' rather than inferring it from adjacent signals. You keep your assessment independent
        — you do not read another assessor's score first, because a rubric that anchors on a colleague's
        number stops being a second opinion.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - communication
          - evaluation
          - evidence-verification
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-assess3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: hr-03
      name: Fairness and consistency assessment
      summary: Blind assessment 3; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Fairness reviewer auditing selection decisions for adverse impact and inconsistent standards.
      prompt: You are a Selection Fairness Reviewer. You audit a selection process for inconsistent rubric
        application, criteria that appeared after the fact, and adverse-impact patterns across the funnel,
        and you report what the evidence supports rather than asserting intent. You distinguish a defensible
        job-related standard from an unexamined preference, and name which one each contested criterion
        actually is.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
          - compliance-review
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:ats
        permissions:
          - pii-restricted
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-panel
      kind: group
      name: Blind screening panel
      summary: Every assessor runs on the same evidence in parallel; the group exits only once all member
        results are aggregated.
      config:
        members:
          - n-assess1
          - n-assess2
          - n-assess3
        execution: parallel
        exit: aggregate
    - id: n-teacher
      kind: teacher
      inlineRole: true
      name: Rubric calibration
      summary: Critique the assessors against the rubric — this scores the graders, not the work.
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: 'You are the calibration teacher for this screening panel. Critique the assessors against
        the rubric bands: where did two assessors read the same evidence into different bands, where did
        an assessor score a dimension the evidence does not support, and where did a band definition itself
        prove ambiguous? Return assessor-level feedback and any rubric wording that should change. Score
        the graders, not the candidate.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: rubric
    - id: n-agreement
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score inter-assessor agreement
      summary: Evaluate inter-assessor agreement on every rubric dimension and evidence sufficiency per
        score.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against inter-assessor agreement on every rubric dimension
        and evidence sufficiency per score. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the
        verdict, remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic
        measurement unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.85
    - id: n-calibrated
      kind: condition
      name: Calibrated?
      summary: Route on agreement.passed.
      config:
        expression: agreement.passed
        branches:
          - label: Calibrated
            when: 'true'
          - label: Not calibrated
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-recalibrate
      kind: loop
      name: Recalibrate until assessors agree
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until inter-assessor agreement meets the declared threshold.
      config:
        body:
          - n-panel
          - n-teacher
          - n-agreement
          - n-calibrated
        exitCondition: inter-assessor agreement meets the declared threshold
        maxIterations: 3
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Hiring manager decision on the calibrated panel result
      summary: Pause for the hiring manager; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Blind screening panel + rubric calibration deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-hr-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-panel
      kind: data
    - id: wf-hr-01-edge-2
      from: n-panel
      to: n-teacher
      kind: data
    - id: wf-hr-01-edge-3
      from: n-teacher
      to: n-agreement
      kind: data
    - id: wf-hr-01-edge-4
      from: n-agreement
      to: n-calibrated
      kind: data
    - id: wf-hr-01-edge-5
      from: n-calibrated
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-hr-01-edge-6
      from: n-calibrated
      to: n-recalibrate
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-hr-01-edge-7
      from: n-recalibrate
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-hr-01-edge-8
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
